plate_comment: Ends the engine retarder TSC1 request: override control mode off, control device none, the torque limit 125 (no limit), and the retarder request timeout, time limit, zero torque timer and speed control flag cleared (was cm848_resetGovernorState)

When governor_feature_config_word bit 0x1000 is set, the transmission holds both an engine retarder torque control request and an engine speed control request, and engine_operating_mode_fuel_demand has reached engine_retarder_shift_assist_fuel_demand_limit, it ends the retarder request (mode off, torque limit 125, the zero torque timer and the speed control flag cleared) (was governor_resetModeStateOnCondition)
